purpose: Test one fixed six-month illusion-momentum hypothesis while separating source-structure evidence from the constrained 2M JPY top-five implementation.

public_author_report.title: モメンタム戦略の開発とその有効性の検証

verified_source_structure: IMOM is cumulative return minus the arithmetic sum of returns over the same window.
The baseline study evaluates six- and twelve-month windows without skipping the most recent month.
The source universe is TSE-listed stocks excluding the foreign section and ETF/ETN.
Source portfolios are formed monthly into ten groups, held for the next month, and equally weighted.
adaptation_differences: The available J-Quants archive begins in August 2021 rather than the source study's 1990-2022 period.
The fixed universe includes the pre-existing 50M JPY median-turnover tradability guard.
The source-structure diagnostic uses archived adjusted price returns; equivalence to the source provider's return series, including distributions, is not established.

The implementable portfolio is long-only, maximum five names, next-open entry, fixed-20 close exit, 100-share lots, and cost/stop constrained rather than a broad next-month equal-weight decile portfolio.

information_timing.actual_month_end_required: A symbol must have a valid adjusted close on each required global TSE month-end; a prior symbol close is never substituted.

universe.survivorship_rule: Use the historical master snapshot available at formation, never current membership.

feature.monthly_return: r_i,m = adjusted_close_i,m / adjusted_close_i,m-1 - 1 using consecutive global TSE month-ends

portfolio.decile_assignment: For descending one-based rank r among n symbols, decile = 10 - floor((r - 1) * 10 / n). Decile 10 is highest IMOM.
portfolio.outcome: adjusted close-to-close price return from formation month-end to the next global TSE month-end

rank_ic.definition: Within each formation month, Pearson correlation of average ranks of IMOM6M and next-month returns, equivalent to Spearman rank correlation with average ranks for ties.

gate_a_source_structure_diagnostic.chronological_halves: Sort monthly spreads by formation date; first floor(n/2) months are the first half and all remaining months are the second half.
gate_a_source_structure_diagnostic.largest_month_removal: Remove exactly the month with the highest decile-10-minus-decile-1 return; break a tie by earliest formation date.
gate_a_source_structure_diagnostic.failure_contract: Freeze the candidate immediately. Do not execute Gate B, validation, or locked OOS.

execution.stop_fill: After applying the session's split factor: raw open when open is at or below stop, otherwise stop when raw low reaches stop.
execution.corporate_action_handling: Apply the archived session AdjFactor to carried raw-price references and divide shares by AdjFactor before evaluating that session.
execution.maximum_drawdown: Peak-to-trough daily mark-to-market portfolio equity decline divided by starting capital.

splits.boundary_rule: A diagnostic month or trade belongs to a split only when its formation, entry if applicable, and next-month or stop/scheduled outcome all finish no later than the split end.

decision_contract.gate_a_fail_or_incomplete: FROZEN_REJECTED_DEVELOPMENT; Gate B and later splits prohibited.
decision_contract.locked_oos_pass: Permits only a separately approved prospective shadow-forward design; it does not authorize paper/live routing.
decision_contract.candidate_failure: End cross_sectional_adaptation_v0 after candidate 2 of 2. Do not immediately test IMOM12M, skip-month, sign reversal, another quantile, regime, HTP, quality, or value variants.

authority_boundary.next_required_action: Explicit review and authorization of this preregistered design before any implementation or computation.
